Grok Bot
What they did
In the thread, one user says Grok Bot can handle routine office work by posting to Reddit and Instagram, checking email, and setting Teams meetings. The source does not explain the workflow, permissions, or review steps for that specific setup; it only presents it as something the bot is able to do.
How it went
The claimed outcome is broad office-day coverage, but the post gives no numbers, examples, or failure cases for this use. Elsewhere in the thread, another commenter says Grok Bot works well for repetitive automations.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Be my assistant for my workday. Each morning, check my email at [email address] and give me a summary of anything urgent, draft replies for the rest, and propose times for the meetings I need to schedule in Teams with [people]. Also prepare [number] social posts for [Reddit community/Instagram account] about [topic]. Before you send any email, create any meeting, or publish any post, show me the exact content and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1x7xrgb/is_grok_bot_still_worth_it
